0022600155.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-4, third in the Central and 3 games back, on a three-game losing streak) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak and 5 games back in the Atlantic) in the Pacers' seventh game of the 2026-27 season. The Pacers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 136-109 win in Brooklyn on October 25, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and Obi Toppin (back soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain).
